title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
slides: Can Muse unlock your entire codebase for you?
Meta trained it on three billion lines of Python.
But it solves tasks humans spend weeks debugging.
Now your team's legacy systems become AI-accessible.
Run one experiment today: let Muse find a bug.
thread_text:
1. Your codebase, unlocked?

Meta's Muse was trained on three billion lines of Python, and it's already fixing bugs that take humans weeks.

2. Legacy no longer means locked

Muse can make your team's oldest systems AI-accessible, turning decades of code into a live, queryable resource.

3. The debugging twist

Instead of just reading code, Muse solves the problems you've been chasing—often in minutes, not days.

4. The real cost of waiting

Every week you delay, your team burns hours on issues Muse could handle in one command.

5. Run this today

Feed Muse a bug your team has ignored for a month. See what it finds. Ready to test it?
